skills.description: Explore requirements and design choices before building a new feature or behavior.
skills.excerpt: Use before creative work: clarify intent, then design.

skills.description: Diagnose defects from evidence and isolate the root cause before changing code.
skills.excerpt: Reproduce the failure, find the root cause, then fix.

skills.description: Write a failing test before implementing or changing behavior.
skills.excerpt: RED, GREEN, refactor: test first, then code.

skills.description: Break a multi-step change into an ordered implementation plan before coding.
skills.excerpt: Produce ordered tasks with verification steps.

skills.description: Execute an existing implementation plan task by task.
skills.excerpt: Work the approved plan in order and verify each step.

skills.description: Run the project's checks and confirm their output before claiming work is done.
skills.excerpt: Evidence before assertions: run tests and linters first.

skills.description: Request a review of completed work before merging or claiming done.
skills.excerpt: Verify the change meets requirements through review.

skills.description: Evaluate and respond to code review feedback with technical rigor.
skills.excerpt: Verify each suggestion before implementing it.

skills.description: Isolate feature work in a separate git worktree before starting.
skills.excerpt: Create an isolated workspace for the change.

skills.description: Split independent tasks across parallel agents with disjoint scope.
skills.excerpt: Delegate independent work with clear boundaries.
